A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the L2 learner is not only able to access the L2 grammar but also to construct a new grammar that is independent from the L1.

The main takeaway from our work is that
L2 learners are not necessarily able to transfer the grammatical knowledge they have from their L1.
L2 learners do not necessarily produce the forms they know.
